description:
Your account at a glance, and what needs you

Returns the signed-in account's wallet, every wallet on the account and its linked wallets, its plan, and two lists of plain sentences addressed to the person. `must_act` is what only the person can do: answer a deal offer (or deposit, consent or launch for one already agreed), register a token page they launched, a token page whose health is falling toward expiry, a pending CLI sign request, the updated Developer Program agreement to sign. `warnings` is what is close to going wrong: the API key's daily quota nearly used, a failing or disabled webhook (store webhooks included), a trial or cancelled plan about to end. Each item ends with the chaindaddy.io link where the person acts, in their own wallet. `unchecked` names any source that could not be read this time; when it is empty, everything was checked.

Needs Sign in with Chain Daddy (scope api:read).
